content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research addresses automated layout composition for regulatory documentation under specific compliance constraints, using rule-based constraint solving to place variable content within fixed structural boundaries.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-05249","field":"abstract","quote":"rule-based composition engine developed to automate the layout of back-of-pack nutrition panels"}]},{"text":"Work examines print workflow standardisation and identifies manual preflighting of artwork as the largest contributor to lead-time variance in short-run production, proposing automated preflight rule sets to reduce approval cycle time.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-05251","field":"abstract","quote":"manual preflighting of customer-supplied artwork was the single largest contributor to lead-time variance"}]},{"text":"Expertise covers file format standards and colour management for artwork exchange between design and production systems, addressing the vendor compatibility constraint in print workflows.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-05250","field":"abstract","quote":"PDF/X-4 and PDF/A-3 against both requirements using a test set of 80 label artwork files"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has demonstrated competence in automated layout composition under structural constraints [SYN-PUB-05249] and understands print workflow bottlenecks in short-run production [SYN-PUB-05251], but published work focuses on regulated label content (nutrition, compliance) rather than general packaging artwork fitting to arbitrary dieline structures, and does not address the geometric panel detection and scaling problems central to this challenge."}
